summary: Shen Feizhi and his fiancée Lu Qian visit a property on Lanxie Road, located conveniently below his former residence. During the visit, they encounter a noblewoman who recognizes Shen Feizhi and expresses disapproval of Lu Qian, comparing her unfavorably to Gu Suizhou. Shen Feizhi manages to appease the woman with a calculated display of politeness. Later, they meet with Lu Fan, a reclusive and traumatized designer, to discuss renovations. Shen Feizhi uses his connection to the Elder Master Shen to coerce Lu Fan into revealing information about a past trauma involving the Shen family, suggesting a deeper, darker history behind the family's influence.
